'''August 2004 East Lansing tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG local tournament held on Saturday 28 August 2004 at 1 pm at Fortress Comics and Games, 425 Albert, East Lansing, Michigan.<ref name="pcf-3830-52379">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52379#52379 East Lansing, MI August 28th 1 pm], noodles, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (11 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905212855/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52379%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Entry was $2.00 with packs as prizes, or free without packs, and players who arrived late took a loss for the first round. The announcement named the organizer as "Matt pietraglo (sp?)".<ref name="pcf-3830-52379" />

Four players took part. The winner was posted as "Matt Pietraglo [sp?]", and the forum user who posted the results, noodles (who signed as b.harris), finished second.<ref name="pcf-3830-53415">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=53415#53415 East Lansing, MI August 28th 1 pm], noodles, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (28 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040905212855/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52379%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
